newsitem.title: GERMANY: Economists see no Buba rate cut Thursday - poll.
newsitem.headline: Economists see no Buba rate cut Thursday - poll.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3.
Armin Kayser, SBC Warburg No. No. Yes.
Nikolaus Keis, Bayer. Vereinsbank No. No. Yes.
Wilfried Bock, Norddt. Landesbank No. No. Yes.
David Brickmann, Yamaichi Int.Europe No. No. Yes.
Stefan Schneider, Banque Paribas No. No. Yes.
Keith Edmonds, IBJ International No. No. Yes.
Nick Stamenkovic, DKB International No. No. Yes.
Stephen Lewis, Londond Bond Broking No. No. Yes.
Robert Prior, James Capel No. No. Yes.
Ulrike Kastens, TCM No. No. Yes.
